verification_report.summary: All deductions pass relative to the accepted prerequisites. The all-current separation argument correctly needs no closedness of ddc C∞; the threshold and nef characterizations follow from the normalized shift identity. The determinant argument uses only the accepted coefficient/determinant construction, smooth Monge–Ampère formula, and nef continuity. Tosatti–Weinkove Theorem 1.2 and (1.2)–(1.4) were checked arXiv-first, then against web and the supplied primary PDF/text: the Ricci, potential, and time conventions match after scaling potentials by 2π, with no time rescaling. The lifetime formula handles t≥0 and both b≤0 cases exactly. No bounded mass, positive lower-volume, null-locus, analytic-support, or flow-convergence claim is used.
